grammar.summary: 本课学习 so...that 结果状语与 make it easy 结构。

points.title: make + it + 形容词 + to do
points.explanation: it 作形式宾语：Shopping made easy. / People are not so honest as they once were. as...as 比较结构的否定。

points.title: as...as 比较结构
points.explanation: not so...as = 不如：People are not so honest as they once were.（人们不如以前诚实了）第一个 as 可换 so。

examples.en: One Monday, there were fewer people in the shop than usual.
examples.cn: 一个星期一，商店里的人比往常少。
